links.outcome: Answer quality (relevance, accuracy, safety, completeness, conciseness) with vs without guideline retrieval grounding
links.effect: RAG significantly outperformed baseline across all criteria (P<.001) by LLM judge; human evaluation confirmed for accuracy, safety, completeness (P<.001); RAG preferred in 92.8% of LLM-judge comparisons and 71.2%-74.8% by humans.
links.quote: The LLM-as-a-judge evaluation showed the RAG system significantly outperformed the baseline across all criteria (P < .001).

screen.reason: The study evaluates the addition of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) grounding to an existing LLM compared to baseline LLM without retrieval, measuring safety, accuracy, and clinical utility using simulated guideline questions and expert clinician review.
